verdict.rationale: HumanLayer's own Slack integration pushes task artifact updates into team channels. That is a first-party notification path, but the docs never say it fires when an agent completes a task or needs input. Remote control from app.humanlayer.com on a phone is a control surface, not an alert, so it is not credited. Missing for 10: documented completion notifications, documented needs-input/approval alerts, push or desktop notification channels, any hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can get notified when an agent completes a task or needs my input

citations.quote: Connect Slack to send HumanLayer task artifact updates into the channels where your team already works.
